Batch_Trans_File_Guide_2: 1. Each mod starts with a '[ModID]' line, followed by four key=value lines:
Batch_Trans_File_Guide_3: name=original name, desc=original description, trans_name=translated name, trans_desc=translated description.
Batch_Trans_File_Guide_5: - Fill in the translation you want.
Batch_Trans_File_Guide_6: - Leave empty or write '# comment' to remove this translation.
Batch_Trans_File_Guide_7: 3. 'name' and 'desc' are for reference only; editing them has no effect.
Batch_Trans_File_Guide_8: 4. To insert a line break in the description, use the <LINE> tag (e.g. 'first line<LINE>second line').
Batch_Trans_File_Guide_9: 5. After editing, save the file, return to the game settings page, and click "Apply All".
Batch_Trans_File_Guide_10: 6. All changes are automatically backed up to the mod's backup folder. If something goes wrong, restore the file to:
Batch_Trans_File_Guide_12: 7. Due to the translation index mechanism, if this mod is not at the top of the mod load order, some translations may not take effect.
Batch_Trans_File_Guide_13: 8. Lines starting with '#' are comments and will be ignored.

TempFile_Guide_1: Write the text you want to replace in this file. The first line is the translated name; the remaining lines are the translated description (use <LINE> for line breaks).
TempFile_Guide_2: If you leave the translated name or description empty, the translation will be removed and reverted to the original. Save and close the file after editing, then click "Confirm Add".
TempFile_Guide_3: Lines starting with '#' are comments and will be ignored.
TempFile_Guide_4: You can disable file format tips in settings; these four lines will no longer appear next time you open the file.
